LiteRT-LM Windows prebuilts differ from the prebuilts in its declared LiteRT source revision; source pins alone do not prove their exact binary provenance.

The Gemma provider prebuilt has no corresponding public implementation. The included LLGuidance C ABI replacement, CPU C API and GREEDY sampler pass focused grammar/sampler tests and real pinned E4B text/tool/vision smoke on macOS arm64. Installed-app, Windows/universal delivery and complete schema semantics remain unverified.
The declared WebGPU build route depends on ml_drift, whose public workspace archive has no URL or SHA-256. Dawn header-source declarations do not establish the exact libwebgpu_dawn binary revision.

The acquired Bazel/Cargo source collections are explicit supersets. The configured macOS arm64 CPU graph has no cc_import; exact source archive omissions and retained membership are verified. Windows/Intel configured graphs, full offline cache replay and exact release notice membership remain unverified.
